Author: PlatyDuckbill
Name: DuckbillFisher
Description:
Let Duckbill guide your next catch.
A fishing companion for FFXIV Korea.

• Browse fish with collection, region and availability filters.
• Check baits, mooch chains and time/weather conditions.
• Prepare baits for favorites or filtered fish, with inventory counts.
• Find owned baits with page markers and in-game UI highlights.
• Open fishing spots directly on the map.
• Get local alerts for favorites, with optional sounds.
• See fish available now or soon in the quick list.
• Follow casts with a timer and personal fishing records.

Open: /dbfs or /duckbillfisher. /dbfs cl: compact list; /dbfs ct: casting timer.
UI: English / Korean. Game names follow your client.

Verified on the supported Korean client and Dalamud build only.
Does not automate fishing.
Punchline: Let Duckbill guide your next catch.
Changelog:
New feature: Collection progress
• Open Collection progress in the main view to see a large regular-fishing summary and ocean-fishing progress by sea area.
• Expand expansions into regions and switch between all fish, big fish including legendary fish, and legendary fish.
• Progress bars adapt to the view width. Hover for full counts, percentages, and unknown states.
• Click an expansion, region, or sea-area bar to open a fish list that stays open until you close it. Clicking another area reuses that list.
• Switch the list between all fish and hiding caught fish. Manual collection settings take priority, and unknown fish remain visible.

Other improvements
• The compact-list button in the main view now toggles it open and closed.
• Added icons to the main navigation tabs.
